disclaimer: CatCheck helps you track litter color and pH readings at home. It does not replace a veterinarian. If your cat shows unusual signs, take them to a vet clinic.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.intro: A few things that keep the community helpful:
rules.respect: Be respectful and don't judge how others care for their cats.
rules.noDiagnosis: Share what you observe; don't diagnose in place of a vet.
rules.privacy: Don't share your own or other people's personal information.
